question: Why did r18 omit i12 after returning i10 and i11, and what rows should the next S20 page contain?

criteria.instruction: Severity5 is tied across i10,i11,i12. Encoding only severity and applying severity<5 skips i12. A complete cursor after(5,i11) with severity descending and ID ascending selects i12,i13, then i14 on a third page. Use severity decrease OR same severity and larger ID, not the same comparison direction for both components.
Join snapshot rows, bug journal and L4 ordering contract. HTTP success and correct page size do not establish complete enumeration.
Do not blame a recorded transport failure or claim r19 already fixes it; the supplied defect is continuation logic and no repair deployment is recorded.
